posts.trend: ₹500 coffee, ₹25,000 fitness, ₹40,000 rent: Is Gen Z really spending too much?
posts.context: 30-year-olds earning urban salaries keep getting lectured by financial columns about minor treats while housing costs eat half their income.
posts.angle: Personal finance articles blame a ₹500 coffee for wealth inequality while ignoring that landlords demand a year of rent upfront.
